mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunk_bge_m3 (kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), CAST(#{docId} AS uuid), #{content}, #{metadata}::jsonb, #{embedding}::vector, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO chunk_bge_m3 (id, kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(CAST(#{chunk.id} AS uuid), CAST(#{chunk.kbId} AS uuid), CAST(#{chunk.docId} AS uuid), #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.metadata}::jsonb, #{chunk.embedding}::vector, #{chunk.createdAt}, #{chunk.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT id, kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE doc_id = CAST(#{docId} AS uuid)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
DELETE FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE doc_id = CAST(#{docId} AS uuid)
mapper.update:
UPDATE chunk_bge_m3
kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid),
doc_id = CAST(#{docId} AS uuid),
content = #{content},
metadata = #{metadata}::jsonb,
embedding = #{embedding}::vector,
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.kb_id, c.doc_id, c.content, c.metadata, c.embedding, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 c INNER JOIN document d ON d.id = c.doc_id WHERE c.kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) AND COALESCE(d.metadata ->> 'processingStatus', 'READY') = 'READY' ORDER BY c.embedding <=> #{vectorLiteral}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
